item.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
item.description: Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

item.title: Israel deports two activists detained on board Gaza flotilla
item.description: Spanish national Saif Abu Keshek and Brazilian Thiago Ávila were detained by Israel after sailing in a Gaza-bound aid flotilla.

item.title: Iran sends response to US proposals to end war
item.description: No details have been released of Iran's response - or the US proposals - designed to bring the war to an end.

item.title: UK warship HMS Dragon heads to Middle East for potential Strait of Hormuz mission
item.description: The Ministry of Defence says the ship will prepare to join an international mission to safeguard shipping, but only when fighting in the region ends.

item.title: Putin says he thinks Ukraine conflict 'coming to an end'
item.description: The Russian leader sees potential for Ukraine negotiations, but condemns the West's backing for President Zelensky.

item.title: Iran demands guarantees for World Cup participation
item.description: The Iranian Football Federation (FFIRI) has presented Fifa with 10 conditions for participation at the World Cup in the US, Mexico and Canada.

item.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
item.description: Abbas Araghchi says the US attacks each time there is a diplomatic solution on the table.

item.title: Another year, another controversy for Eurovision - but fans are sticking by it
item.description: Fans are grappling with how to react to the withdrawal of Spain, Ireland and others over Israel's participation.

item.title: Dress made from 500 loaves stuns African film awards
item.description: Celebrities, filmmakers and creators put up a performance at Africa's biggest night of film and fashion.

item.title: Australia's right-wing One Nation party scores historic parliamentary win
item.description: One Nation gains its first seat in the lower house, in a by-election seen as a key test for the populist party.
